==English==

===Etymology===
From {{uder|en|la|ēveniō||happen, fall out, come out}}, from {{m|la|ē||out of, from}} (short form of {{m|la|ex}}) + {{m|la|veniō||come}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɪˈviːn/}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|obsolete}} To [[occur]]; to [[happen]]; to come to pass.

====Synonyms====
* {{l|en|come to pass}}, {{l|en|occur}}, {{l|en|transpire}}; See also [[Thesaurus:happen]]
